snippet.title: Teeter Torture (1982 Prototype Arcade Game)
snippet.description:
Teeter Torture is a rare prototype arcade game made by Exidy in 1982. Only one cabinet was ever produced. 

The gameplay is simple: 

Balance the teeter totter while shooting down weights. If you stay on one side too long, you will press down on one of the two dynamite plungers and the barrel of dynamite in the center will explode. The falling weights can cause the teeter totter to become off-balanced or collide with you if you do not shoot them down.

Thanks to the president of Exidy, H.R. Kaufmann, the game ROM has been placed on the official MAME website for free download (personal non-profit use only):

http://mamedev.org/roms/teetert/
